_comment: Hand-maintained mirror of src/main/resources/seed/demo-dataset.json's eight catalogue items.
No day4/tools/regenerate_canonical.py exists in this repo, so there is nothing to run - edit
this by hand alongside demo-dataset.json and keep DemoDataSeederTest.datasetAgreesWithDay1Fixtures
The published identity of everything the seed writes: ids, titles, byte lengths and the
acquisition terms each book carries. Anyone building against the seed without running this app
should build against this file instead, so a diff here is worth a second pair of eyes.
originalLength is the plaintext byte length. The entity calls the same number sizeBytes.
cipherLength = 12 (nonce) + originalLength + 16 (GCM tag), and exists only where encrypted.
opdsForImperial is institution-specific on purpose: licence model and copy count come from the
entitlement, not the book. Imperial is the only seeded institution with grants, so it is the
reference. null means that institution gets no acquisition link, either because nothing entitles
it or because the book is not both PUBLISHED and READY.

constants._encryptionAlgorithmNote: The OPDS 'encrypted' link property is the Readium encryption extension, where algorithm is required and must be a URI. This is the XML Encryption 1.1 identifier for AES-256-GCM. The bare string 'AES-256-GCM' from the source of truth fails strict OPDS validation.

items.title: Law and Ecology
items.note: Real EPUB, OPEN_ACCESS, so it appears for every institution including one with zero entitlements and one that is suspended. Unencrypted, per the OPEN_ACCESS rule.

items.title: Professional Competence And Higher Education
items.note: Real PDF, ELITE. pub_crc has no publisher/collection grant to Imperial, so ent_dev_elite (ITEM scope, copies 2) exists specifically for this book. canPersist is false because the tier is ELITE, independent of the entitlement's copy count.

items.title: Doctor Dolittle - Chapter 2: Animal Language
items.note: Real audio (public domain Doctor Dolittle, chapter 2), OPEN_ACCESS. Unencrypted for two independent reasons that happen to agree: open access is never encrypted, and audio is never encrypted.

items.title: Doctor Dolittle - Chapter 1: Puddleby
items.note: Real audio (chapter 1), ELITE, so encrypted like any other locked asset - audio is not exempt above OPEN_ACCESS. Reached through ent_imp2 (PUBLISHER scope pub_rtlg, UNLIMITED); no new entitlement needed. canPersist is false because the tier is ELITE, independent of the entitlement being UNLIMITED.

items.title: The Politics of Coalition in Korea
items.note: Real EPUB, ELITE, deliberately placed in col_law2024 so the COLLECTION grant (ent_imp1, copies 2) beats the PUBLISHER grant (ent_imp2, UNLIMITED) on the same book - the scope-precedence demonstration item_42 used to carry.

items.title: Playful Identities
items.note: Real PDF, SUBSCRIPTION. In no collection, so it is reached through ent_imp2 (PUBLISHER scope pub_rtlg, UNLIMITED), not a narrower grant.

items.title: Contract Law in the Construction Industry Context
items.note: Real EPUB, added alongside the six kept dev fixtures rather than replacing one. SUBSCRIPTION, rides ent_imp2 (PUBLISHER scope, UNLIMITED).

items.title: Humanitarianism and Challenges of Cooperation
items.note: Real EPUB, added alongside the six kept dev fixtures. SUBSCRIPTION, rides ent_imp2 (PUBLISHER scope, UNLIMITED). Its upload originally failed on a ZipInputStream/data-descriptor bug in EpubArchive.unzip; kept as the id that proves the fix.
